scenarios.title: Flanking gives a non-flanking blocker -1/-1

setup.notes: Benalish Cavalry (2/2 flanking) has been declared as an attacker.

decisions: A attacks player B with Benalish Cavalry.
B blocks Benalish Cavalry with Grizzly Bears.
The flanking trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.
No other spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: non_flanking_blocker
variants.expected: Flanking triggers and Grizzly Bears gets -1/-1 until end of turn (1/1). Benalish Cavalry deals 2 damage, so Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard; Grizzly Bears deals 1 damage to Benalish Cavalry, which survives with 1 damage.

variants.label: flanking_blocker
variants.delta: B's blocker is a second Benalish Cavalry instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Flanking does not trigger. The blocker stays 2/2. Both Benalish Cavalry deal 2 damage to each other and both move to their owners' graveyards.

variants.label: attacker_without_flanking
variants.delta: A's attacker is Grizzly Bears instead of Benalish Cavalry.
variants.expected: No flanking trigger. Both Grizzly Bears are 2/2, deal 2 damage to each other and both move to their owners' graveyards.

scenarios.title: Two instances of flanking trigger separately

setup.notes: Cavalry Master gives other creatures A controls with flanking flanking, so Benalish Cavalry has two instances. Only Benalish Cavalry attacks; Cavalry Master stays home.

decisions: A attacks player B with Benalish Cavalry only.
B blocks Benalish Cavalry with Grizzly Bears.
Both flanking triggers go on the stack; both players pass and both resolve.
No other spells or abilities are used.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Two flanking triggers resolve and Grizzly Bears gets -1/-1 twice (-2/-2, 0/0). Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard before combat damage. Benalish Cavalry takes no damage; B takes no damage (Benalish Cavalry stays blocked).

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Cavalry Master is not on A's battlefield, so Benalish Cavalry has only its own flanking.
variants.expected: One flanking trigger: Grizzly Bears becomes 1/1. It deals 1 damage to Benalish Cavalry and dies to its 2 damage. Benalish Cavalry survives with 1 damage.

variants.label: flanking_blocker
variants.delta: B's blocker is a Benalish Cavalry instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Neither instance of flanking triggers because the blocker has flanking. The blocker stays 2/2; both Benalish Cavalry deal 2 damage to each other and die.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge must treat the granted Flanking as a second instance; if it dedupes keywords, the two_instances variant degrades to one trigger.
